title: KittenModpack
body:
KittenModpack is a survival-focused Minecraft modpack designed for an exciting, balanced, and immersive gameplay experience. Originally planned for a survival series, it combines exploration, creativity, and challenge while keeping performance smooth.

What It Does:

Expands Survival Gameplay: New mobs, biomes, and environmental challenges make your world feel alive.

Enhanced Crafting & Progression: From basic tools to advanced automation, progression feels rewarding.

Adventure & Exploration: Discover unique structures, hidden treasures, and lore-rich environments.

Quality-of-Life Improvements: Performance optimizations and UI enhancements let you focus on the fun.

Flexible Playstyle: Build, explore, farm, or adventure—the choice is yours.

Why Choose KittenModpack?
Every mod is carefully selected to create a survival experience that’s engaging, fun, and perfect for both casual players and content creators. Whether you want to start a series or just enjoy an enriched survival world, this modpack is designed to deliver.

Recommended:

Minecraft Version: 1.21.1

Performance Mods: Sodium, Lithium, and others to optimize gameplay

Suggested Playstyle: Survival, Exploration, Adventure, Base-Building
